title: Black Lantern
description: Quiet Spine moved stolen identities through paired human couriers. Rescue Mara Venn, recover her reconstruction cipher, and decide whether the route is evidence worth preserving or a weapon that must be destroyed.

gq003_02_obj_meet_iris.description: Iris has reconstructed part of Quiet Spine. Meet her and learn who is still trapped inside the route.

gq003_03_obj_read_report.description: Review Iris's analysis of Mara Venn, Pair 07-B, and the Black Lantern transfer route.

gq003_06_obj_reach_yard.text: Reach the Black Lantern freight yard.
gq003_06_obj_reach_yard.description: Find the municipal-salvage front Patch identified and locate Pair Seven's transfer records.

gq003_07_obj_remain_undetected.description: Avoid raising the yard alarm while you identify and mark the expedited shipment.

gq003_08_obj_investigate_yard.description: Scan the transfer board, neural stabilizers, and conscious-transport restraint case.

gq003_09_obj_read_handoff.description: The restraint case contained a conversation between Sato and K. Morita.

gq003_10_obj_plant_beacon.description: Mount Iris's beacon on the Black Lantern routing hardware without interrupting its heartbeat.

gq003_11_obj_breach_dispatch.description: Use the authenticated route to identify Pair 07-B and Mara's current clinic.

gq003_12_obj_leave_yard.description: Clear the yard before Black Lantern can isolate the compromised route.

gq003_14_obj_reach_clinic.description: Go to the clinic holding Mara Venn.

gq003_15_obj_clear_security.description: Resolve the armed clinic personnel guarding Mara and the neural jammer.

gq003_16_obj_disable_jammer.description: Shut down the field compressing the foreign memories inside Mara's implant.

gq003_17_obj_release_mara.description: Open Mara's restraint and keep the clinic from reclaiming her.

gq003_18_obj_escort_mara.text: Escort Mara out of the clinic.
gq003_18_obj_escort_mara.description: Keep Mara with you through the clinic exits and reach the stabilization point.

gq003_19_obj_stabilize_mara.text: Protect Mara while Iris stabilizes her implant.
gq003_19_obj_stabilize_mara.description: Hold the perimeter until Iris isolates the foreign memory loops.

gq003_20_obj_meet_iris.text: Meet Iris at the safe site.
gq003_20_obj_meet_iris.description: Bring the stabilized Mara to Iris and decide how to recover Pair 07-B's cipher.

gq003_22_obj_enter_vehicle.description: Use Patch's temporary van to pass the interchange's first security scan.

gq003_23_obj_wait_for_patch.description: Let Patch join you before taking the van to the freight interchange.

gq003_24_obj_drive_interchange.description: Take Patch's van to the parking row marked by Iris's beacon.

gq003_25_obj_steal_carrier.description: Find the refrigerated Pair 07-B box truck and take control of it.

gq003_26_obj_drive_carrier.text: Drive the carrier to the reconstruction relay.
gq003_26_obj_drive_carrier.description: Move Pair 07-B to the relay before Black Lantern can revoke its cipher.

gq003_28_obj_enter_relay.description: Reach the relay interior and secure the core before the retrieval team does.

gq003_29_obj_defeat_retrieval.description: Resolve the Black Lantern team sent to recover Pair 07-B.

gq003_30_obj_investigate_relay.description: Scan the cipher rack, reconstruction core, and courier ledger.

gq003_33_obj_operate_core.text: Jack in to the reconstruction core.
gq003_33_obj_operate_core.description: Apply your decision to the Black Lantern index and wait for the core to confirm it.

gq003_34_obj_leave_relay.description: Clear the site while Ghostline verifies what survived.

gq003_35_obj_deliver_package.description: Deliver the preserved cipher or signed destruction receipt to Ghostline's drop point.

gq003_36_obj_respond_ghostline.description: Review the outcome with Morrow, Iris, and Patch.

entry_01_msg_quiet_spine_opened.text: Need you to meet Iris. Quiet Spine finally opened. She says the cache contained a person who is still alive.

entry_01_msg_yard_alias.text: Yard calls itself Kuroda Municipal Salvage. It is neither Kuroda, municipal, nor interested in salvage.

entry_02_msg_gate_phrase.text: Freight gate phrase is BLACK LANTERN, PAIR SEVEN, PRIORITY WEATHER.

entry_04b_msg_phrase_repeated.text: BLACK LANTERN, PAIR SEVEN, PRIORITY WEATHER. Look annoyed if anyone asks.

entry_05_msg_route_ready.text: If anybody asks what it means, tell them Morita changed it twice already.

entry_01a_msg_clean_yard.text: Clean enough to make me jealous. I try that and a door asks for three references.

entry_01b_msg_detected_yard.text: Freight crew is shouting into every channel they own. Clinic will be awake. Probably armed. Definitely rude.

entry_02b_ch_how_many.text: How many courier runs did you touch?

entry_03a_msg_confession.text: Knew they used people. Did not know they used the people. I believed not asking kept the route cheap and me alive.

entry_03b_msg_four_runs.text: Four sealed cases. Two dead drops. No names.

entry_04_msg_vehicle_sent.text: I have a van at the safe site. Registry clears the first scan. After that, we improvise in person.

entry_07_msg_confession_postscript.text: Should've told you what I knew. Next time I sell confidence, ask what I'm using as collateral.

entry_01_msg_trace_ready.text: The beacon resolved Mara's clinic. I have the location.

entry_02a_msg_clean_yard.text: The beacon authenticated without an alarm. Black Lantern still believes Pair Seven is on schedule.

entry_02b_msg_detected_yard.text: Yard raised an intrusion flag. The beacon is still transmitting, but the clinic will know somebody touched the route.

entry_04b_msg_jammer_warning.text: It is stronger than the clinic walls. Disable it before you search for Mara.

entry_05_msg_clinic_marked.text: Clinic marked. Bring Mara out conscious if you can.

entry_02_msg_iris_burn.text: The same route carries names for every stolen identity. Leave it open and anyone with the cipher can reconstruct them again.

entry_04_msg_iris_present.text: Preserve it and the people already inside remain inventory. A future rescue does not cancel a present weapon.

entry_06_msg_iris_erase.text: There is no harmless copy. Erase the index and issue the wipe. Mara keeps her life. The route loses everyone else's.

entry_08b_msg_burn_confirmed.text: Confirmed. Revoke every package, then destroy the local key.

entry_02a_msg_route_preserved.text: You gave Morrow a map made of people. Make sure he remembers what the symbols mean.

entry_02b_msg_route_burned.text: Mara remembers one apartment now. Her own. That will have to count as a victory.

entry_01_msg_morrow_preserve.text: The ledger carries Morita's live attestation. Preserve the route and I can follow the next handshake upstream.

entry_03_msg_morrow_future.text: Burn it and Morita disappears behind the organization that paid him. We save today's couriers and guarantee replacements tomorrow.

entry_05_msg_morrow_trace.text: V, keep the line open. We trace Morita, copy what we need, then close it from the top.

entry_07a_ch_preserve.text: Keep the line open. Find Morita.

entry_07b_ch_burn.text: Erase the route. Nobody gets the names.

entry_08a_msg_preserve_confirmed.text: Confirmed. Authenticate the cipher and leave the uplink intact.

entry_09_msg_operate_core.text: Decision recorded. Operate the reconstruction core.

entry_01a_msg_route_preserved.text: Black Lantern is still carrying traffic. Now it carries our shadow with it.

entry_01b_msg_route_burned.text: You protected the couriers and destroyed the only clean path upward. Iris calls that mercy. I call it an expensive preference.

entry_03a_msg_stealth_succeeded.text: The freight yard still treats Pair Seven as an internal failure. No public description, no bounty. Clean work.

entry_03b_msg_stealth_failed.text: Freight security circulated your description. Black Lantern knows the route was attacked, even if it does not know what survived.

entry_05a_msg_leverage.text: No. They were leverage. Our disagreement is whether destroying the leverage removes the hand holding it.

entry_05b_msg_adapt.text: Correct. You changed the route, not the destination. We adapt.

entry_06_msg_payment.text: Payment transferred. Keep the channel open. Black Lantern was a route, not the destination.

expedited_handoff.title: Archived conversation: Sato and K. Morita
expedited_handoff.text:
SATO: Kabuki classifier is gone. Pair Seven needs moving tonight.

K. MORITA: Mnemonic subject first. Cipher remains on the freight route.

SATO: Subject is rejecting the graft.

K. MORITA: Rejection proves the original personality is still present.

SATO: Clinic wants authorization to wipe her.

K. MORITA: Denied. An empty courier cannot confirm the reconstruction.

SATO: And after confirmation?

K. MORITA: The clinic has standing disposal terms. Do not ask a question your invoice already answers.

reconstruction_report.title: QUIET SPINE RECONSTRUCTION / BLACK LANTERN
reconstruction_report.text:
AUTHOR: IRIS
STATUS: PARTIAL RECONSTRUCTION
SOURCE: QUIET SPINE CACHE

The source contains indexed mnemonic fragments and the route metadata required to recombine them.

PAIR 07-A
MNEMONIC SUBJECT: MARA VENN
FUNCTION: carries autobiographical fragments embedded as personal experience
CURRENT STATE: active / graft rejection detected

PAIR 07-B
CIPHER SUBJECT: FREIGHT VEHICLE BL-07B
FUNCTION: carries reconstruction key, fragment index, and route attestation
CURRENT STATE: expedited handoff

Neither half is sufficient alone. The mnemonic subject cannot identify the foreign fragments. The cipher can identify them but contains no experiential payload.

ROUTING ALIAS: BLACK LANTERN
DISPATCH AUTHORITY: K. MORITA
TRIGGER FOR EXPEDITED HANDOFF: KABUKI CLASSIFIER OFFLINE

ASSESSMENT:
Quiet Spine did not move files. It moved the instructions for rebuilding people.

clinic_intake.title: Patient intake: Lantern 07-A
clinic_intake.text:
PATIENT ALIAS: LANTERN 07-A
INTAKE CONDITION: ambulatory, disoriented, combative when addressed as MARA
IMPLANT: obsolete Zetatech mnemonic co-processor, aftermarket maintenance
GRAFT ACCEPTANCE: 61 percent and declining

REPORTED CONTAMINATION:
- recalls three apartments under three legal names
- identifies ventilation faults in buildings not present in employment record
- responds to the name AKIKO during REM intrusion
- repeatedly asks whether the hallway has been moved

CLIENT INSTRUCTION:
Maintain conscious state. Do not wipe without K. MORITA authorization.

CLINIC NOTE:
Patient keeps repairing the room thermostat. We disconnected it. She repaired the wall sensor instead.

mara_maintenance_ticket.title: Mara Venn: unsent maintenance ticket
mara_maintenance_ticket.text:
TENANT: MARA VENN
BUILDING: H8 SERVICE STACK / UNIT 42
TICKET: AIR HANDLER CYCLING FALSE HUMIDITY

Replaced the intake sensor again. Controller still reports moisture when the duct is dry. Fault is upstream, probably the building relay copying stale readings into every apartment loop.

If management closes this as USER ERROR one more time, tell them the system is remembering weather that is not there.

Draft not submitted.
